applicability.skipReason: The web-research step was skipped, so there are no sources to deepen.

applicability.when: The work has a commercial market and either this product's addressable market is not already sized or this feature changes that sizing.
applicability.skipReason: This scope has no commercial market to size (for example, an internal tool, migration, or infrastructure-only change), or this product's addressable market is already sized and unchanged by this feature.

applicability.when: The value, viability, cost or priority of the idea is still undecided, so a business case must precede the build decision.

applicability.when: Feature Specs or related code already exist for the affected area, so overlaps and gaps must be surfaced before the spec is authored.

applicability.when: The scope carries replay, state, ownership, recovery or failure risks that need adversarial analysis before planning.
applicability.skipReason: The scope carries no replay, state, ownership, recovery or failure risk beyond what the spec already covers.

intent: Fix a reported defect at the root cause its end-to-start trace proves, guarded by a regression test that fails without the fix and passes with it.

outcomeGates.when: A canonical spec or test-case artifact governs the affected area, and behavior or a public contract changed or that spec lacked the case the bug exposed

applicability.when: The bug is a Spec Bug (the canonical spec documents the wrong behavior), or an Ambiguous case the user resolved needs the spec corrected before regression TCs are written.
applicability.skipReason: Code Bug: the canonical spec already describes the intended behavior, or no canonical spec covers the affected area.

applicability.when: The fix is large (triage size M or larger) and creates new user-facing UI like a feature (a new page/view, component or dialog), so explore mockups run (scope gate first: 1-3 drafts or skip), are opened in the browser and, with 2-3 drafts, the user picks one before planning.
applicability.skipReason: The fix creates no new UI surface: it is backend-only or corrects existing UI, so there is no new direction to choose.

applicability.when: Triage is size M or larger, the bug is a Spec Bug, the fix touches several test cases, or the fix crosses modules, changes a public contract, data/schema or security-sensitive code, or the investigation left more than one candidate fix layer.
applicability.skipReason: Small local Code Bug fix touching at most one test case, with one owning layer and no contract, data or security change; /fix plans inline and the investigation report records the fix layer, blast radius and rollback.

applicability.when: A canonical spec or TC registry covers the affected area, so the regression case must be recorded as a TC.
applicability.skipReason: No canonical spec or TC registry covers the affected area; the regression test itself names the Business Intent / Invariant Guarded.

applicability.when: The TC change goes beyond a single regression case (several TCs or invariant/property TCs), or triage flagged size M or larger or a risk.
applicability.skipReason: No TC changed, or only the single regression TC changed; the nested change review covers it.

applicability.when: A canonical spec or TC changed in this run, or the fix changes specified behavior or a public contract.
applicability.skipReason: No canonical spec or TC exists or changed for the affected area, and the fix restores already-specified behavior.

applicability.when: The user explicitly requests E2E work, such as asking to include, write, call, run, or do E2E or end-to-end verification.
applicability.skipReason: No explicit E2E request was found in the user prompt; the optional E2E handoff is disabled by default.

applicability.when: The fix changes user-facing behavior, so a reviewer needs a demo path.
applicability.skipReason: The fix changes no user-facing behavior to demonstrate.

applicability.when: The run added, changed, or removed E2E tests or accepted baselines, fixed product source, or changed specs or documented behavior; record the terminal verify evidence.
applicability.skipReason: Verification-only run: no test, baseline, product source, spec, or documented behavior changed, so docs-manager --mode=update has nothing to record; cite the unchanged diff and the terminal verify report.

applicability.when: This workflow is the TOP-LEVEL invocation: the user ran /workflow-e2e or /start-workflow workflow-e2e directly, and no parent workflow (workflow-feature, workflow-bugfix, workflow-big-feature, workflow-greenfield-init) runs it as a step.

applicability.when: Implementation exists for the specified capabilities, or the spec was not synced against code in this session, so it may be stale versus code.
applicability.skipReason: The canonical spec is greenfield or provisional with no implementation, or it was synced against code in this session, so there is nothing for it to be stale against.

applicability.when: A spec item implies new or changed entities, aggregates, invariants, lifecycle or state transitions, cross-service ownership, or data migration or seed needs.
applicability.skipReason: No spec item implies a new or changed domain entity, lifecycle, ownership boundary or data migration.

applicability.when: The selected decomposition or slice risks need adversarial replay, state, ownership, recovery or evidence analysis.
applicability.skipReason: No selected slice carries replay, state, ownership, recovery or evidence risk that scenario analysis would change.

applicability.when: The spec is large (isLargeIdea true), spans four or more capabilities, or has cross-capability dependencies, so a decomposition plan drives PBI slicing and order.
applicability.skipReason: The spec covers one to three capabilities with no cross-capability dependency, so the coverage matrix decomposes it without a separate plan.

applicability.when: The plan step ran in this run.
applicability.skipReason: The plan step was skipped, so there is no plan to validate.

applicability.when: The PBI has a user-facing UI surface.
applicability.skipReason: The PBI is backend-only, so there is no UI surface to mock.

applicability.when: The work has a user-facing UI surface that needs tech-agnostic UI specs.
applicability.skipReason: The work is backend-only, so there is no UI surface to specify.

applicability.when: More than one PBI was generated in this run, or the PBI must be ranked against an existing backlog.
applicability.skipReason: Exactly one PBI was generated and no backlog ranking was requested; its priority is the RICE/MoSCoW value pbi --mode=refine wrote to its frontmatter.

applicability.when: Several PBIs were generated, the spec is large, or stakeholders asked for a review deck.
applicability.skipReason: A single small PBI whose artifacts are reviewed directly, and no stakeholder deck was requested.

intent: Turn UI-bearing canonical specs into a reviewed, journey-validated interactive mock app built in a user-picked design direction.

applicability.when: The governing spec's artifact profile has a companion-artifact link (the mockup: frontmatter key or its native equivalent) that does not yet point at the final mockup.
applicability.skipReason: The artifact profile declares no companion-artifact link, or the spec already links the final mockup.

intent: Bring test specs, feature docs and integration tests back in line with the code after a change, with every changed behavior tested green.

applicability.when: The spec [mode=tests] step added or changed at least one test case in this run.
applicability.skipReason: No test case was added or changed in this run, so there is no case to review.

applicability.when: An added or changed test case has no executing integration test, or changed behavior is not yet covered by one.
applicability.skipReason: Every added or changed test case already has an executing integration test covering it (see the case-to-test map).

applicability.when: Integration test code was written or changed in this run.
applicability.skipReason: No integration test code was written or changed in this run, so there is no new test code to review.

applicability.when: Integration test code was written or changed in this run, or an integration test covers behavior the triggering change altered.
applicability.skipReason: No integration test was written or changed and none covers the altered behavior; the test gate proves the remaining suites.

intent: Add or extend idempotent, command-based seeders that create realistic QC happy-path data for a feature area.

applicability.when: The seeded data reaches a configured experienceVerification surface whose reviewOn trigger intersects the change, or the seeder creates or changes data a QC/operator actually observes through a running application, API, CLI, or generated artifact; when the latter is true without usable configuration, run the skill and record ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED.
applicability.skipReason: After inspecting docs/project-config.json and the seeder diff, no configured or likely observable surface consumes the seeded data; record NOT-APPLICABLE with evidence citing the inspected paths.

intent: Write spec-traced integration tests for existing code and prove they pass with real assertion value (write), or drive the integration-test suite, or the named target, to repeatably green by fixing each failure at its owning layer (green).

applicability.when: A target behavior has no current case in the configured case owner (new or changed behavior, or a missing or stale case).
applicability.skipReason: Every target behavior already has a current case in the configured case owner; the spec sync gate still reconciles case-to-test links.

applicability.when: The spec [mode=tests] step added or changed at least one case in this run.
applicability.skipReason: No case was added or changed in this run, so there is no case to review.

applicability.when: Test coverage changed materially, or a doc records evidence, coverage or test counts this run changed.
applicability.skipReason: Coverage did not change materially and no doc records evidence, coverage or test counts this run changed; the spec sync gate already updated the case links.

intent: Write spec-traced integration tests for existing code and prove they pass with real assertion value (write), or drive the integration-test suite, or the named target, to repeatably green by fixing each failure at its owning layer (green).

outcomeGates.when: A verify run reported a failing test
A fix changed tested behavior or a test case

applicability.when: A fix changed tested behavior, a test case, or the name or location of a traced test.
applicability.skipReason: No fix changed tested behavior, a test case, or the name or location of a traced test, so the case owner and its coverage links are unchanged.

applicability.when: A fix landed in this run, or a doc outside the spec and the integration-test reference records test counts, coverage or evidence this run changed.
applicability.skipReason: No fix landed and no doc records a test count, coverage claim or evidence this run changed.
